newsitem.title: USA: High Plains Wheat - Gulf basis bids firm.
newsitem.headline: High Plains Wheat - Gulf basis bids firm.

text.p: Basis bids for hard red winter wheat were firmer Thursday at the Gulf of Mexico and at scattered mills in eastern and central Kansas, dealers in the central U.S. High Plains said.
"We raised the bid to stay competitive. But there's not a hell of a lot (of wheat) moving around so it doesn't really matter," one central Kansas dealer said.
One Oklahoma said Wednesday's movement had been "slower than slow" and said farmers currently had no reason to sell.
"They realize that they missed out on the opportunity to sell at lifetime highs, so why sell now?" he said.
But he also predicted that selling could resume soon because farmers would need to generate cash to pay off their fertilizer bills.
Another Oklahoma dealer said heavy rains over the last few days had delayed planting of hard red winter wheat in the northern part of the state.
Basis values in cents/bu against KCBT wheat, cash=dollars/bu.
